reviews.title: MIGHT NEED TO HAVE BIOS FLASHED BEFORE WORKING
reviews.comment: THIS BOARD WAS DOA UPON RECIEVING.  I have built thousands of systems, and after installation into case. This would not boot or do anything. Replaceed all hardware with other hardware, (no worky ) then simply removed the board and tried booting out of case with PSU, MEMORY and CPU .....NOTHING !  Went online and downloaded the latest BIOS, Extracted it to a USB STICK formatted in Fat32. Then with only PSU ( NO MEMORY OR PROCESSOR) ...Flashed the new bios into the board (Videos on how to do this, on Youtube ) AND POOF everything worked as it should.  Interesting fact, I had built 5 last week ALL THE SAME COMPONENTS, only one board required this action.
reviews.author: Ron Oetzel
